ui.reply: I am here. Let us start.
ui.escorting: Stay beside the guide. They will wait if you move too far away.
ui.holding: Stay near the work until it is finished.
ui.patrolLine: We are keeping the roads clear. Check the village map if you need directions.
ui.guardianThreat: Stand back. Something is holding me inside this seal.
ui.regroupLine: You made it back. Rest and tend your wounds before you try again. The meeting point is still there.
ui.guardStandDown: Left guard, right guard, stand down. The seal keeper has earned passage. Open the road to the council hall.
ui.waitingEscort: Return to the person waiting for you
ui.escortUnavailable: The route to the meeting point is blocked. Re-enter the area to try again.
ui.escortClear: Press E to clear the obstacle

openings.nameless: Take this end of the rope. I will hold the lower end. Pull when I call.
openings.water: Do not drink it. If you can still stand, help me bring them ashore.
openings.fire: If you find her, tell her I am waiting outside. Do not let her try to stand alone.
openings.lightning: Stay out of the standing water. Hold the ground rod while I shut the relay off.
openings.wind: The courier has never been late. This morning two people came through with the same wax seal.
openings.earth: Three knocks. They can hear us. Hold the support. Leave the large slab where it is.
openings.wood: Another root just cracked. Listen close. Sap is still flowing beneath it.
openings.ice: The small footprints lead to the pines. Please stay off the middle of the lake.
openings.light: Those weapons belong to the village guards. The marks on the lock will tell us who is still inside.
openings.dark: The Light guards are behind us. Let us find a way for them to get the residents out before we reach the center.

nameless.title: A Light for the Crossing
nameless.intro: The light at the Tea Road turnoff went out. Travelers take the wrong downhill path instead of turning toward Echo Bridge. Help me bring a new lamp to the turnoff.
nameless.end: You can see the way home from here. Tea is on me.

steps.label: Walk with the lamp bearer
steps.description: Tra is carrying a replacement lamp so travelers do not take the wrong downhill turn. Escort her to the turnoff, then secure the lamp in its bracket.

destination.label: Tea Road turnoff for Echo Bridge
destination.arrival: The lamp is at the turnoff. Secure it to show travelers the way to Echo Bridge.

obstacle.label: Clear the crate at the turnoff
obstacle.text: Tra has both hands on the lamp. Move the crate so she can pass without dropping it.

steps.label: Secure the roadside lamp

water.title: A Delivery of Clean Water
water.intro: If they fetch water themselves, they have to pass the poisoned barrels. I will go with you.
water.end: Now they have drinking water while we find out who did this.

steps.label: Escort the carrier to the water point
steps.description: Van is carrying clean water to households staying away from the relief barrels. Escort her to the station, then open the tap for the residents.

destination.label: Water station in the riverside hamlet
destination.arrival: The water is at the station. Open the tap so Van can serve the nearby households.

obstacle.label: Wedge the slippery board
obstacle.text: The board is slipping on the wet ground. Wedge it before Van carries the water across.

steps.label: Open the clean water tap

fire.title: The Cold Forge
fire.intro: I put out the forge. Hold the lever while I pull out the old pin.
fire.end: Hear how steady that is? The hillside farmers will have plows tomorrow.

steps.label: Hold the air vent
Hold the lever while the forge restarts

lightning.title: A Light Through the Storm
lightning.intro: The people in the fields can only see rain. The road lamp has to guide them here.
lightning.end: They have turned toward us. Leave the light on overnight.

steps.label: Escort the lamp bearer to high ground
steps.description: People in the fields cannot see the shelter through the rain. Escort Am with the lamp to the post on the rise, then light it.

destination.label: Beacon post on the storm-shelter rise
destination.arrival: The lamp is at the beacon post. Light it to guide people in the fields back to shelter.

obstacle.label: Shelter the lamp through a lightning burst
obstacle.text: Am stops when lightning strikes close to the trail. Shelter the lamp until the burst passes.

steps.label: Light the storm beacon

wind.title: The Wind Signal
wind.intro: Follow me to the slope. Wait until the kite turns into the wind before pulling.
wind.end: They answered. The next party can set out.

steps.label: Escort the guide to the slope
steps.description: The wind has shifted and the lower station does not know whether to send the couriers. Escort Dieu to the signal mast, then hold the latch long enough for them to see it.

destination.label: Signal mast on the Kite Meadow slope
destination.arrival: You have reached the mast. Hold the latch so the lower station can read and answer the signal.

obstacle.label: Retie the kite line
obstacle.text: A gust pulled the signal line free. Steady the kite while Dieu reties it.

steps.label: Hold the wind signal in place

earth.title: Knocks Below
earth.intro: Two quick knocks, that is me. Listen for an answer before you pull the pin.
earth.end: This way is clear. No one has to go down alone now.

steps.label: Inspect the tracks by the mine entrance
Hold the support while the passage is opened
Escort the mine inspector to safety
steps.description: The reopened side passage is still at risk of rockfall. Escort Thach to the roll-call point so he can confirm no one was left behind.

destination.label: Roll-call point outside the quarry
destination.arrival: Thach is clear of the rockfall area and confirms the passage is open. Receive your reward here.

obstacle.label: Clear loose rock at the side shaft
obstacle.text: Thach stops at the loose rubble. Clear the path without disturbing the brace.

wood.title: A Second Nursery
wood.intro: Get the trays clear of the standing water. We can bring the seedlings back when the old tree recovers.
wood.end: With this place, everything no longer depends on one tree.

steps.label: Escort the seedling carrier
steps.description: The seedlings could drown beside the poisoned roots. Escort Ha with the trays to the dry nursery, then water them there.

destination.label: Backup nursery beside the Herb Garden
destination.arrival: The trays are at the dry nursery. Water them to keep the seedlings alive while the old roots recover.

obstacle.label: Brace a board over the flooded patch
obstacle.text: Mud covers the trail and could tip the seed trays. Secure the board before the trays cross.

steps.label: Water the seed trays in the new nursery

ice.title: A Fire Through the Night
ice.intro: The wagon driver is still outside. The firewood is ready. Bring the driver in first.
ice.end: Leave a small fire burning. The next traveler will see it.

steps.label: Escort the traveler to the hearth
steps.description: The traveler is exhausted and cannot find their way in the storm. Escort them to the hearth, then shield the fire from the wind.

destination.label: Snow hamlet warming hearth
destination.arrival: The traveler is at the hearth. Shield the fire so it can catch and warm them.

obstacle.label: Put up the roadside windbreak
obstacle.text: The exhausted traveler has to stop in the wind. Put up the screen so they can catch their breath.

steps.label: Shield the hearth while the fire catches

light.title: Lighting the Glass Crossing
light.intro: It is too dark to see the cracks. Shine the lamp on that bracket.
light.end: The guards can bring the elders across now.

steps.label: Inspect the crack by the bridge bracket
Secure the reflector lamp

dark.title: Lighting Lantern Street
dark.intro: The doors are shut because they think the soldiers are still outside. Let us light the street so they know it is safe.
dark.end: Tomorrow I will hang a light at each door that has someone home.

steps.label: Escort the resident through the dark street
steps.description: Residents still keep their doors shut because they think the occupiers are outside. Escort Dom to the first post and light it to show the street is safe.

destination.label: Lamp post at the entrance to Lantern Street
destination.arrival: You have reached the first post. Light it so residents know it is safe to come out.

obstacle.label: Remove the street barricade
obstacle.text: Residents barred the street with timber to keep the soldiers out. Clear the way for the lamp keeper.

steps.label: Light the first lantern on the street

water-base: They are breathing steadily. Leave the lines in place until I bring help to get them ashore.
fire-jail: The key is by the door. Do not lift me yet. Bring Dan in. I have something to tell you when I can think clearly.
fire-general: Keep the ledger. The corrections are intact. I want to face Xich Nham and name the people he left behind.
wind-courier: Let them go. Look at the mark on this seal. It leads to where they are holding the Wind Eagle.
wind-eagle: The wind has returned. Tell Thanh Vu the mountain courier route is clear.
earth-base: The line has stopped, but those wheel tracks are fresh. A shipment got away before we arrived.
ice-coast: The guards are down. Look out to sea. They are raising the anchor.
light-battalion: The council entrance is open. The prisoners are still behind us. Go before the commander seals it again.
crescent-light: The seal has broken. Open the prison and bring the survivors into the light.
dark-battalion: They withdrew from the main road. Follow that glowing seal to whoever is holding the Jade Deer.
crescent-wood: The Jade Deer is still breathing. Two links are holding it here. We will disconnect them one at a time.
crescent-ice: I can no longer hear his orders. That seal still holds some energy. Read it before you touch it.
crescent-gatekeeper: I am free, but the current has not stopped. Get the residents out, then ask him where the gate is.
invasion-vanguard: The vanguard has fallen back. Check the injured and keep the lanterns lit until everyone is accounted for.
